build_rgb_stacking_env: build an RGB stacking environment with state-only observations and shaped reward for robotic stacking tasks
create_observation_set: create an observation set enum with state-only, vision-only, or combined observations for the RGB stacking environment
run_sparse_reward_env: run the RGB stacking environment with sparse reward that returns 1 when red is stacked on blue and not touching the robot
test_imitation_learning_obs: test the interactive imitation learning observation set with joint angles, poses, and front camera pixels
review_distance_delta_obs: review the distance delta observation function that computes the difference between two observation keys
